record.body: R46 materially changed the reachable frontier. Producer-local sensor manufacture is no longer the immediate bottleneck: exact repository census facts can now be deterministically compiled into replication targets, qualification gaps, evidence-root requirements, receipts, and standing observations. Current frontier: (1) independently execute compiled target in ggen@f4e1bce1efdcdc4f6c2531be9f66070950f7ec93; (2) independently execute compiled target in chatgpt-cloud-elixir against a newly re-resolved exact head; (3) issue per-consumer receipts/falsifiers; (4) measure dependency-relief conversion; (5) enumerate additional reachable exact repository targets; (6) calibrate cross-repo reuse/duplication/orphan sensors; (7) feed qualified consumer receipts back into Project memory; (8) measure R_observed and causal independence; (9) only then retry 1000X admission. Weakest multiplier remains independent consumer realization, but rollout topology is now executable rather than rediscovered. standing=PARTIAL_ALIVE because compiler is ALIVE while non-producer consumers are not yet independently qualified.
